info.name: FidduPay Merchant API SDK
info.description: Official Merchant API documentation for FidduPay Node.js SDK users.

request.description: Returns aggregate statistics (total, active, flagged, recent) and total aggregate balance in USD for all platform customers.

Sweeps ALL locked assets from the customer sub-wallet to your Master Wallet. Gas fees are automatically deducted from your native ledger balance. For EVM, the system auto-funds gas dust internally — customers never see gas transactions.

Sweep modes:
- ALL (default): sweeps every asset
- NATIVE_ONLY: sweeps only native coins (ETH, BNB, SOL…)
- STABLE_ONLY: sweeps only stablecoins (USDT, BUSD…)
- SPECIFIC: sweeps a single crypto_type (requires crypto_types array)
Sweep a specific asset from the customer sub-wallet. Omit 'amount' to sweep the maximum available locked balance.

Returns the verified, merchant-linked deposit address for the customer. If no wallet exists for the requested crypto_type/network, one is automatically provisioned. Response: { external_id, crypto_type, deposit_address, provisioned }. provisioned=true means the wallet was just auto-created.

Sweep only stablecoin balances (USDT, BUSD, etc.) locked by the customer to your Master Wallet. This non-custodial sweep deducts gas fees from your merchant native ledger — no external transfers visible to the customer.

Scans ALL customers linked to your merchant account and auto-provisions any missing wallet designations. Returns { status, checked_customers, repaired_wallets }. Run this after onboarding migrations or if you suspect fund-loss from unlinked wallets.

Resolves an on-chain address back to the owning customer. Returns { found, status (ACTIVE|HISTORICAL), customer, wallet }. HISTORICAL means the address was previously linked but the customer now has a new designated wallet. Returns 404 + { found: false } if not matched.

Full snapshot of all customer wallets. Returns { active: [...], historical: [...] }. Active = currently designated wallets. Historical = re-provisioned wallets with a reason field. Use for compliance audits and gap detection.
